name: Asahi Pentax K1000
note: same camera filed twice. Asahi Optical Co. is the maker and Pentax the line; the bodies are engraved 'Asahi Pentax', so a handful of upstream titles carry the maker word and the rest do not. Nothing distinguishes the two records but that prefix.

name: Asahi Pentax ME
note: maker-prefix duplicate of the plain record, as above.

name: Asahi Pentax MX
note: maker-prefix duplicate. Both records scored 0.935 against the query 'Asahi Pentax MX' once the prefix-drop variant landed, i.e. a dead tie between two spellings of one camera — exactly the ambiguity a merge exists to remove.

name: Asahi Pentax Spotmatic
note: maker-prefix duplicate. The Spotmatic subvariants (II, F, 500, 1000) are all filed without the prefix, so the base body was the odd one out.

name: Olympus SP-565 Ultra Zoom
note: same camera under the expanded and the abbreviated marketing suffix. Olympus used 'UZ' on the SP line and 'Ultra Zoom' on the earlier Camedia C-series; upstream titles mix the two, so the SP-565 ended up as two records.

name: Mamiya RZ 67
note: same camera, spaced spelling. normalize() keys 'RZ 67' and 'RZ67' as different strings so the two spellings never cluster on their own — the same failure already corrected for the Pentax 6x7.

name: Mamiya RB 67 Professional
note: spaced-spelling duplicate, same cause as the RZ 67.
